cold.about: Cold Claude: no guide and no examples. The writer sees only the content brief and one line on who Dan is. This is the floor every other setup is measured against.

guide.about: Today's guide as a writing skill would load it: DAN-VOICE.md, every file in _shared/voice/ (the Part 1 examples, the P2A example files and the swearing rules), WRITING-RULES.md and the personal facts entry.
